summary:
The booking form stayed on screen after the user submitted valid visit details, rather than completing the booking and displaying its confirmation.
Check the booking submission handler and its success-state display. After a valid free-visit submission, show a confirmation containing a reference code so it can be saved.
evidence: objective_contradiction: Checkpoint assertion failed: "a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown"
one_liner: The completed free-visit form did not show a booking confirmation or reference code after it was submitted.
reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown"

verdict.root_cause: The booking form stayed on screen after the user submitted valid visit details, rather than completing the booking and displaying its confirmation.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent entered the requested date, selected noon, accepted the waiver, and clicked the labeled “Confirm my free visit” button. The screenshots show those requested values selected before submission. The failure therefore was not caused by the agent using the wrong details or omitting the waiver; the expected post-submit confirmation was absent.
